Okay, team of one. Leadership wanted an AI strategy, so I made one: Shifty. He used to work nights here. Now he IS the AI. Train him until he passes the AWS AI Practitioner exam. No budget. Infinite synergy.

Welcome to the AI initiative. Nobody asked me to lead it, which is how you know it's leadership. This is Shifty-1. Train him to pass AIF-C01. I'll handle the slide deck. You handle literally everything else.
